This notebook recomposes the verified figure panels into a reader-facing sequence.
It does not refit a model or replace any underlying analysis. Run it after the
canonical manuscript candidates and the taxonomic-resolution exploration:

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/build_story_reorganized_figures.qmd [candidate-output-directory]
```

```{r}
#| label: build-story-reorganized-figures
#| echo: true
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
})

abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

repo_root <- function() {
  root <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!file.exists(file.path(root, "R", "figure_style.R"))) {
    abort("Run this notebook from the phage_uv_ecology_analysis repository root")
  }
  root
}

promote_file <- function(source, destination) {
  dir.create(dirname(destination), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  temporary <- paste0(destination, ".incoming")
  if (file.exists(temporary)) unlink(temporary)
  if (!file.copy(source, temporary, overwrite = TRUE, copy.mode = TRUE)) {
    abort("Could not stage %s", basename(destination))
  }
  if (file.exists(destination)) unlink(destination)
  if (!file.rename(temporary, destination)) abort("Could not promote %s", basename(destination))
}

write_checksums <- function(output_dir, staging) {
  checksum_path <- file.path(output_dir, "output_checksums.md5.tsv")
  files <- list.files(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, all.files = FALSE)
  files <- files[file.info(files)$isdir %in% FALSE & normalizePath(files) != normalizePath(checksum_path)]
  files <- sort(files)
  table <- data.table(
    path = sub(paste0("^", normalizePath(output_dir), "/?"), "", normalizePath(files)),
    bytes = file.info(files)$size,
    md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(files))
  )
  staged <- file.path(staging, "output_checksums.md5.tsv")
  fwrite(table, staged, sep = "\t")
  promote_file(staged, checksum_path)
}

root <- repo_root()
source(file.path(root, "R", "figure_style.R"))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
project_data <- "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569"
output_dir <- if (length(args)) args[[1L]] else file.path(
  project_data, "derived", "manuscript_figure_candidates"
)
resolution_dir <- file.path(project_data, "derived", "taxonomic_resolution_exploration")
de_dir <- file.path(project_data, "derived", "full_transcriptome_de")

paths <- list(
  metadata = file.path(root, "metadata", "sample_metadata.tsv"),
  mds = file.path(output_dir, "tables", "mds_coordinates.tsv"),
  summary = file.path(output_dir, "tables", "figure_summary.tsv"),
  functional = file.path(output_dir, "tables", "functional_condition_panel.tsv"),
  top_mag = file.path(output_dir, "tables", "top_mag_condition_panel.tsv"),
  registry = file.path(output_dir, "candidate_figure_registry.tsv"),
  family_profile = file.path(resolution_dir, "tables", "family_top25_community_profile.tsv"),
  family_colours = file.path(resolution_dir, "tables", "family_microshades_colour_key.tsv"),
  de = file.path(de_dir, "tables", "de_condition_adjusted.tsv"),
  filtering = file.path(de_dir, "tables", "filtering_summary.tsv")
)
missing <- names(paths)[!file.exists(unlist(paths))]
if (length(missing)) abort("Missing inputs: %s", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

staging <- file.path(dirname(output_dir), sprintf(".story-figure-staging-%d", Sys.getpid()))
if (dir.exists(staging)) unlink(staging, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(staging, "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(staging, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
on.exit(unlink(staging, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)

metadata <- fread(paths$metadata)
mds <- fread(paths$mds)
figure_summary <- fread(paths$summary)
functional <- fread(paths$functional)
top_mag <- fread(paths$top_mag)
family_profile <- fread(paths$family_profile)
family_colours <- fread(paths$family_colours)
filtering <- fread(paths$filtering)

condition_values <- c(
  Control = phage_uv_condition_colours[["control"]],
  `Phage-UV` = phage_uv_condition_colours[["treatment"]]
)
condition_lower_values <- c(
  control = phage_uv_condition_colours[["control"]],
  treatment = phage_uv_condition_colours[["treatment"]]
)

# Figure 1: establish the longitudinal system, show its community, then show
# whole-transcriptome sample geometry.
design <- copy(metadata)
design[, `:=`(
  cycle_number = as.numeric(cycle),
  membrane_y = fifelse(condition == "control", 2, 1),
  plot_y = fifelse(condition == "control", 2, 1) + fifelse(phase == "initial", 0.09, -0.09)
)]

p_design <- ggplot(
  design,
  aes(cycle_number, plot_y, colour = condition, shape = phase,
      group = interaction(condition, phase))
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = condition_lower_values) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = phage_uv_phase_shapes) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:3, labels = paste("Cycle", 1:3), limits = c(0.7, 3.3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("Phage-UV", "Control"), limits = c(0.65, 2.35)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Membrane", tag = "A") +
  theme_phage_uv(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none", plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )

mds[, `:=`(
  condition = factor(condition, levels = c("control", "treatment")),
  phase = factor(phase, levels = c("initial", "backflush"))
)]
p_mds <- ggplot(mds, aes(MDS1, MDS2, colour = condition, shape = phase)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.0) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = cycle_label), size = 2.7, show.legend = FALSE,
    box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.25, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 79569
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = condition_lower_values, labels = c(control = "Control", treatment = "Phage-UV"),
    name = "Membrane"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = phage_uv_phase_shapes, labels = c(initial = "Initial", backflush = "Backflush"),
    name = "Phase"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Leading logFC dimension 1", y = "Leading logFC dimension 2", tag = "C") +
  theme_phage_uv(base_size = 9) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

family_profile[, `:=`(
  sample_label = factor(sample_label, levels = c("C1-I", "C1-B", "C2-I", "C2-B", "C3-I", "C3-B")),
  condition_label = factor(condition_label, levels = c("Control", "Phage-UV")),
  display_category = factor(display_category, levels = rev(family_colours$display_category))
)]
family_palette <- setNames(family_colours$colour, family_colours$display_category)
family_legend <- family_colours[category_type == "top25 named" | display_category == "Other phyla"]
family_legend[, legend_label := fifelse(
  display_category == "Other phyla", "Other phyla", paste(phylum, display_category, sep = " | ")
)]

p_community <- ggplot(
  family_profile,
  aes(sample_label, relative_abundance, fill = display_category)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(2.5, 4.5), colour = "#D8D8D8", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_col(width = 0.82, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.08) +
  facet_grid(condition_label ~ ., scales = "fixed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = family_palette,
    breaks = family_legend$display_category,
    labels = setNames(family_legend$legend_label, family_legend$display_category),
    drop = FALSE,
    name = "Family (phylum | family)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(
    x = "Cycle and phase in chronological order",
    y = "Relative abundance among MAG-mapped metagenomic reads",
    tag = "B",
    caption = paste(
      "Top 25 classified families are named; pale shades pool remaining or unresolved families within each phylum.",
      "I, initial; B, backflush. Descriptive profiles; membrane identity is confounded with condition."
    )
  ) +
  theme_phage_uv(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", legend.text = element_text(size = 6.1),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7.2), legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.31, "cm"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 6.4, hjust = 0),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE, override.aes = list(colour = NA)))

figure_community <- (p_design | p_mds) / p_community +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.72, 1.28), heights = c(0.55, 1.65))
community_path <- file.path(staging, "figures", "community-transcriptome-trajectory.pdf")
ggsave(community_path, figure_community, width = 13.5, height = 8.8, device = grDevices::pdf)

# Figure 2: move from the complete adjusted-condition landscape to functional
# rank coherence and organism-resolved coherence.
de <- fread(paths$de, select = c("feature_id", "logFC", "logCPM", "FDR"))
de[, supported := FDR < 0.05]
de[, higher_in := factor(fifelse(logFC >= 0, "Phage-UV", "Control"), levels = c("Control", "Phage-UV"))]
context <- de[supported == FALSE]
context_index <- unique(round(seq(1, nrow(context), length.out = min(20000L, nrow(context)))))
landscape <- rbindlist(list(
  context[context_index][, display_class := "Context sample"],
  de[supported == TRUE][, display_class := "BH FDR < 0.05"]
), use.names = TRUE)

summary_values <- setNames(figure_summary$value, figure_summary$metric)
p_landscape <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = landscape[display_class == "Context sample"], aes(logCPM, logFC),
    shape = 1, colour = "#A8A8A8", size = 0.5, stroke = 0.25, alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = landscape[display_class == "BH FDR < 0.05"], aes(logCPM, logFC, colour = higher_in),
    shape = 16, size = 0.62, alpha = 0.48
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.35, colour = "#555555") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1), linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dotted", colour = "#777777") +
  annotate(
    "label", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.15,
    label = sprintf(
      "%s tested features\n%s at BH FDR < 0.05\n%s also |log2FC| >= 1",
      format(summary_values[["retained_features"]], big.mark = ","),
      format(summary_values[["supported_features"]], big.mark = ","),
      format(summary_values[["supported_abs_logFC_1"]], big.mark = ",")
    ),
    size = 2.8, linewidth = 0.25, colour = "#222222", fill = "white"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = condition_values, name = "Higher expression") +
  labs(
    x = "Average log2 CPM", y = "Phage-UV - control log2 fold-change", tag = "A"
  ) +
  theme_phage_uv(base_size = 9) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

functional[, `:=`(
  label = factor(label, levels = rev(functional[order(tier, set_id), as.character(label)])),
  higher_in = factor(higher_in, levels = c("Control", "Phage-UV"))
)]
p_functional <- ggplot(functional, aes(signed_log10_fdr, label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#555555", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-log10(0.05), log10(0.05)), colour = "#888888",
    linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = functional[supported == FALSE], shape = 1, colour = "#777777",
    size = 2.7, stroke = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = functional[supported == TRUE], aes(fill = higher_in), shape = 21,
    colour = "#222222", size = 3.1, stroke = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = functional[supported == TRUE], aes(label = sprintf("BH FDR = %.2g", FDR)),
    hjust = -0.08, size = 2.7, colour = "#222222"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_values, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.3))) +
  labs(
    x = "Signed -log10(BH FDR)\nControl higher-ranked (negative); phage-UV higher-ranked (positive)",
    y = NULL, tag = "B"
  ) +
  theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

mag_counts <- data.table(
  higher_in = factor(c("Control", "Phage-UV"), levels = c("Control", "Phage-UV")),
  MAGs = as.numeric(summary_values[c("control_higher_MAGs", "phage_uv_higher_MAGs")])
)
p_mag_counts <- ggplot(mag_counts, aes(higher_in, MAGs, fill = higher_in)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62, colour = "#222222", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = MAGs), vjust = -0.45, size = 3.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_values, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14))) +
  labs(x = "Higher-ranked genes", y = "Supported MAGs", tag = "C") +
  theme_phage_uv(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 18, hjust = 1), plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

setorder(top_mag, median_logFC)
top_mag[, `:=`(
  display_taxon = factor(display_taxon, levels = rev(display_taxon)),
  higher_in = factor(higher_in, levels = c("Control", "Phage-UV"))
)]
strip_x <- min(top_mag$median_logFC) - 0.28
phylum_values <- phage_uv_phylum_colours[unique(top_mag$phylum_group)]
p_mag <- ggplot(top_mag, aes(median_logFC, display_taxon)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#555555", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(aes(x = strip_x, colour = phylum_group), shape = 15, size = 3.0) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = higher_in), shape = 21, colour = "#222222", size = 3.0, stroke = 0.4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = phylum_values, name = "Phylum") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_values, name = "Higher-ranked genes") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.8))) +
  labs(x = "Median gene-level phage-UV - control log2 fold-change", y = NULL, tag = "D") +
  theme_phage_uv(base_size = 8.2) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical",
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(order = 1), colour = guide_legend(order = 2, nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))

figure_response <- (p_landscape | (p_functional / p_mag_counts)) / p_mag +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.45, 1), heights = c(1.05, 1.5))
response_path <- file.path(staging, "figures", "transcriptome-response-architecture.pdf")
ggsave(response_path, figure_response, width = 13.5, height = 10, device = grDevices::pdf)

required_figures <- c(community_path, response_path)
if (any(!file.exists(required_figures)) || any(file.info(required_figures)$size == 0)) {
  abort("One or more story-reorganized PDFs were not rendered")
}

inventory <- data.table(
  artifact = basename(required_figures),
  story_role = c(
    "experimental system -> community trajectory -> transcriptome geometry",
    "complete expression landscape -> functional coherence -> organism-resolved coherence"
  ),
  source_boundary = c(
    "community profile is descriptive and derived from MAG-mapped metagenomic reads",
    "complete tested feature universe; membrane identity is confounded with condition"
  )
)
fwrite(inventory, file.path(staging, "tables", "story_reorganized_figure_inventory.tsv"), sep = "\t")

for (source_path in list.files(staging, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)) {
  if (file.info(source_path)$isdir) next
  relative <- sub(paste0("^", normalizePath(staging), "/?"), "", normalizePath(source_path))
  promote_file(source_path, file.path(output_dir, relative))
}

registry <- fread(paths$registry)
registry[artifact %chin% c(
  "global-transcriptome-structure.pdf", "functional-organism-restructuring.pdf"
), status := "legacy_layout_preserved"]
additions <- data.table(
  artifact = basename(required_figures),
  status = c("allocated_main_figure_1", "allocated_main_figure_2"),
  panels = c(
    "experimental design; top-25 family community trajectory; sample MDS",
    "adjusted-condition expression landscape; functional rank tests; supported MAG counts; top organism effects"
  ),
  boundary = c(
    "Community profile is descriptive; MAG-mapped metagenomic reads; membrane identity remains confounded with condition",
    "Complete tested universe; competitive rank coherence; SOS transcription is not direct DNA-damage evidence"
  )
)
registry <- rbindlist(list(registry[!artifact %chin% additions$artifact], additions), use.names = TRUE)
registry_stage <- file.path(staging, "candidate_figure_registry.tsv")
fwrite(registry, registry_stage, sep = "\t")
promote_file(registry_stage, paths$registry)
write_checksums(output_dir, staging)

cat(sprintf("Created two story-reorganized manuscript candidates in %s\n", output_dir))
unlink(staging, recursive = TRUE)
```
